role: fresh binary relation symbol read in place of logical equality (relational reading)
notes: Not in the signature; any binary relation may interpret it. Chosen instead of \(\approx\), which sheet:ordered-superposition uses for identity-semantics equations and the w02-p02-028 annex for its own fresh relation symbol.

role: translation replacing every equation r=t by r eq t in a literal clause or clause set
notes: Leaves terms unchanged; injective on literals (thm:p02-w02b-p02-026-translation).

role: expansion of a structure interpreting eq as identity
notes: Same notation and role as in the w02-p02-028 annex (there for its fresh symbol).

role: clausal equality axioms of a symbol set / of the symbols of a clause set
notes: Clauses (E1)-(E5). Same glyph family as \(\mathrm{Eq}_{\mathcal L}\) (def:p01-w02-p01-025-eq-axioms, sentences) and \(\mathrm{Eq}\) (w02-p02-028 annex, quantifier-free formulas): related role, different syntactic form.

role: set of constant function and relation symbols occurring in a clause set
notes: Determines which congruence clauses are added.

role: subterm at a position and replacement at that position
notes: Positions are finite sequences of positive integers (annex:p02-w02b-p02-026-superposition-sound); the sheet's s[l'] and s[r] are s[l']_p and s[r]_p.

role: class of an element under the eq-relation; induced assignment; quotient structure
